newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanguang's shareholders to discuss rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Nanguang's shareholders to discuss rights plan.

text.p: Shenzhen Nanguang (Group) plc Ltd said on Wednesday its shareholders will meet on February 25 to vote on the firm's plan to make a three-for-10 rights offer this year.

The offer, tentatively priced at between five and eight yuan per rights share, requires the final go-ahead from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the firm said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

If the issue proceeds, Nanguang would use the bulk of proceeds raised from the offer to build a hotel in Nanning, capital of southwestern Guangxi province, in partnership with a domestic enterprise, it said. It gave no more details.
Nanguang, which is involved in hotel, property management and bicycle manufacturing, now operates two hotels respectively in Shenzhen and Beijing.

In an interim report, Nanguang said first-half 1996 net profit rose eight percent to 29.69 million yuan from 27.49 million yuan in the 1995 period due to the opening of a 30-million-yuan 200-room Gelanyuntian Hotel in Beijing last May.
Nanguang said the completion of the Beijing project was only the first step in the firm's plan to establish a nationwide presence in the hotel sector.
